# Governing Thought

The opportunity is a niche within a mature market that relaxes the binary
underservice-vs-mature contradiction.

## MECE Support

1. A mature market can still contain pockets of acute underservice.
2. The niche thesis supersedes the binary s-curve framing.
3. Retaining the JTBD underservice as a niche claim restores consistency.
